title: Hearty Cheese Argentinian Cheese Stew
description: A comforting and malty argentinian stew featuring melted cheese and whole black peppercorns served in a cazuela. This lacto-vegetarian-friendly dish is perfect for a cold winter evening.

ingredients.name: kochkorn
ingredients.notes: ferment-jang, or substitute with a similar condiment

ingredients.notes: whole, for added depth of flavor

instructions: Heat a cazuela over medium heat.
Add the kochkorn and toast for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the bay leaves, whole black peppercorns, and red wine (if using) to the cazuela.
Pour in the whole milk and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let cook for 10-15 minutes, until the stew has thickened slightly.
Stir in the sharp cheddar cheese and parmesan cheese, until melted and well combined.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the Hearty Cheese Argentinian Cheese Stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs (optional).
